environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'data-plane' running on GKE 1.27. The telemetry-ingest pod has a ClusterIP service exposed on port 8080. No network policies applied. The Istio sidecar is injected but running in PERMISSIVE mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication set to PERMISSIVE). Any pod in any namespace can reach the service directly. The native addon (native_parser.node) is compiled without stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector) and ASLR is disabled in the container (kernel.randomize_va_space=0 via securityContext). No AuthorizationPolicy resources exist in the mesh.
